description: This file defines the DataGroupPermissionCollection class, which extends AttributeBag and provides a method to convert stored permission objects into an array format for external use. It appears to be part of a human resource management system's authorization module.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing data group permissions, capable of outputting permissions as an array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the collection of ResourcePermission objects into an array with permission flags for each data group.
